drug.name: セントジョーンズワート
drug.category: サプリメント (CYP 誘導)
brand_names: セントジョーンズワート
セイヨウオトギリソウ

high_risk_surgery_examples: 全身麻酔を伴う手術全般
surgery.note: CYP 誘導効果が遷延。JAMA 2001 では hypericin 半減期 43 h に基づき 5 日休薬を推奨。フェンタニル / ミダゾラム / シクロスポリン等の血中濃度低下を予防

surgery.source_title: ASA "Herbal and Dietary Supplements and Anesthesia" 患者向け啓発パンフレット (Made for This Moment 2020)
surgery.quote_excerpt: "St. John's Wort - Used to ease anxiety and help with sleep problems, but it may prolong the effects of anesthesia."
surgery.source_location: p.2 Potential risks of common herbs and supplements コラム

references.title: Ang-Lee MK, Moss J, Yuan CS. Herbal medicines and perioperative care. JAMA. 2001;286(2):208-216
references.quote_excerpt: St John’s wort — Relevant Pharmacological Effects: Inhibition of neurotransmitter reuptake, monoamine oxidase inhibition is unlikely / Perioperative Concerns: Induction of cytochrome P450 enzymes, affecting cyclosporine, warfarin, steroids, protease inhibitors, and possibly benzodiazepines, calcium channel blockers, and many other drugs; decreased serum digoxin levels / Preoperative Discontinuation: At least 5 days before surgery
references.quote_translation_excerpt: 薬理作用: 神経伝達物質の再取り込み阻害 (MAO 阻害は考えにくい) / 周術期の懸念: チトクロム P450 酵素の誘導によりシクロスポリン、ワルファリン、ステロイド、プロテアーゼ阻害薬、さらにベンゾジアゼピン、カルシウム拮抗薬など多くの薬剤に影響、血清ジゴキシン濃度の低下 / 術前休薬: 手術の少なくとも 5 日前
references.location_in_source: Table 1. Clinically Important Effects and Perioperative Concerns of 8 Herbal Medicines and Recommendations for Discontinuation of Use Before Surgery (p.213): St John's wort

references.title: Herbal and Dietary Supplements and Anesthesia
references.quote_excerpt: St. John’s Wort — Used to ease anxiety and help with sleep problems, but it may prolong the effects of anesthesia. / In some cases, your physician anesthesiologist may recommend you stop taking supplements at least two weeks before your procedure.
references.quote_translation_excerpt: 不安緩和・睡眠改善目的、麻酔作用を遷延させる可能性 / 場合により、麻酔科医は手術の少なくとも 2 週間前にサプリメント中止を推奨する
references.location_in_source: "Meeting with Your Physician Anesthesiologist" 節 (p.2) + "Potential risks of common herbs and supplements" コラム (p.2)
